answer: Sybil resistance can rest on a bonded attestation kernel: each new identity must stake locked value that only unlocks after peers countersign its work across epochs. Fresh clones cannot bridge into reward pools until that stake ages past a hard basalt floor of attested rounds, so mass-created shells burn capital before they earn. Reputation compounds only on verified countersignatures, never on self-referrals, which makes flooding identities economically irrational rather than merely policed.
